paper_title: Non-Convex Matrix Completion Against a Semi-Random Adversary
statement: Since we do not know how to obtain a deterministic version of Lemma 12, we turn our attention to Lemma 13. Lemma 13 is only used in more recent non-convex analyses (e.g., (Sun and Luo, 2015; Ge et al., 2017)). We replace Lemma 13 with the following (stronger version of the) lemma, which states that if W is close to the all ones matrix J (which is guaranteed by our preprocessing algorithm), then the norm of kXY > kF is preserved after we weight the entries by W . Recently, (Chen and Li, 2017) has independently obtained a deterministic inequality similar to Lemma 14.
